pages.text: [#](53341a)A vampire does not sleep in a bed. The sun makes ordinary beds inadvisable, and there is a certain indignity to them regardless. The coffin is better: sealed against daylight, and appropriate to the condition.[#]()
pages.title: The Coffin

pages.text: [#](53341a)Shift-right-click to open the lid, and right-click to enter and sleep. Any player may use it, but for vampires it resolves the problem of daylight with characteristic directness.[#]()
[#](53341a)Planks, logs, and a bed, in the proportions shown. The result is more durable than it looks.[#]()
